results.question: What advice did Zei pass along for the Arctic soldier smuggling messages?

results.question: How do the shrines work in the semifinal version of Minpentai?
results.answer_fact: Every thousand turns, changes inside a shrine are XORed onto areas near its corners, then the shrine resets to a default rock.
results.answer_as_shown: The semifinal round adds five “shrines” – one at the board centre and one along each edge. Every thousand turns the contents that have been changed inside a shrine are XOR‑applied to the cells near its four corners, then the shrine resets to a default rock formation.
